name: javamark-claude-plugins
description: Personal plugin marketplace for AI-assisted software development and Spec-Driven Development

plugins.name: sdd-toolkit
plugins.description: Spec-Driven Development Toolkit: Create specifications, derive features, and have them reviewed. Use this plugin for SDD workflows and spec creation.

plugins.name: quarkus-toolkit
plugins.description: Build Quarkus features: BCE scaffolds with Panache and LangChain4j, OpenAPI specs, and token budgets for AI services. Use this plugin when creating Quarkus modules, designing REST APIs, or limiting LLM context, cost and quota.

plugins.name: review-toolkit
plugins.description: Code reviews with specialized agents for architecture, security, test coverage, and Quarkus best practices. Use this plugin for systematic code quality checks.

plugins.name: doc-toolkit
plugins.description: Create documentation and blog posts: Technical docs, ADRs, and blog articles from Java projects. Use this plugin for documentation tasks and content creation.

plugins.name: frontend-toolkit
plugins.description: Frontend development with TailAdmin, Alpine.js, and Quarkus templates. Build prototypes, dashboards, and forms. Use this plugin for UI development.

plugins.name: wiki-llm
plugins.description: An Obsidian knowledge base that Claude writes and you read: sources become linked pages, plain Markdown, no database. Follows Karpathy's LLM wiki idea. Use this plugin to ingest sources, ask your wiki questions, and keep session learnings.

plugins.name: evolve
plugins.description: Iteration lab: let Claude improve a repository round by round on its own branch, with scans, measured guardrails, one commit and tag per round, and a local dashboard. Modes: invent (new ideas) and modernize (behaviour must not change).
